Most Valuable Cards · 390px

Mocked UI context, actual components. Captured with Playwright using test-only auth-module substitution and intercepted API responses. Fixtures contain 1,043 priced cards, 37 unpriced cards, and quantity-inclusive totals. No real user session, database writes, or production auth bypass. These screenshots verify frontend behavior, not backend privacy enforcement or database performance.

The running phone-preview server was left untouched. The browser script bundles current components in memory; the isolated entry is not imported by App. Click any image for its full-resolution PNG.
